findings.title_zh: 式 7.1 的英文对边说明误指风险；独立段落中必须点名所用锐角
findings.title_en: Name the acute angle used by each opposite-side relation
findings.evidence: The triangle has a right angle at C, with AB as its hypotenuse and CB opposite this angle
findings.detail_zh: 已保存的英文第 13 段把这句话单独显示，alpha 和 CAB 在上一段。当前句子唯一点名的是 C 点直角，this angle 很容易指向它；但 C 点直角的对边是 AB，不是 CB。CB 对应的是 A 点的入射角 alpha。第 15 段又用 AD is opposite the angle，而 beta 和 ABD 只在上一段，重现了依靠上一张阅读段落猜角的缺口。这不是公式错误，也不是原图几何判定，而是关键科学解释的指代缺陷。
findings.detail_en: Saved paragraph 13 names only the right angle at C before saying CB is opposite this angle. Its natural local referent is C, whose opposite side is AB. The intended angle is alpha at A (CAB), introduced in the preceding paragraph. Saved paragraph 15 similarly leaves the angle opposite AD unnamed after beta/ABD were introduced in the preceding paragraph. An independent child-facing paragraph should not require guessing which angle its sine relation uses.
findings.required_change_zh: 只改现代说明，明确 CB 是 A 点入射角的对边，AD 是 B 点折射角的对边；不要改源公式、编号或图稿。点名 A/B 可使用普通文本，以免新增数学片段破坏冻结的公式序列。
findings.required_change_en: Identify CB as opposite the incidence angle at A, and AD as opposite the refraction angle at B. Preserve the exact source equations, numbers and mathematical-token order; the point names can be ordinary prose.

findings.title_zh: 英文现代图标签仍是中文
findings.title_en: Modern English figure-label metadata remains Chinese
findings.evidence: All three modern label fields contain 图 195, while the modern caption text is Figure 195.
findings.detail_zh: 英文主标题及正文图引用已是英文，图题 text 也已译为 Figure 195；但顶层图标签、fig 块标签及 cap 块标签仍为图 195，因此现代本地化文本元数据不一致。原始 source.data、source_text 和 printed_title 是忠实来源信息，不因含中文而要求改动。
findings.detail_en: The English title, prose reference and caption text are localized, but the modern top-level figure label and both modern prose label fields still say 图 195. This is a text-metadata inconsistency, not a claim about what an untested renderer displays. Chinese inside the immutable source snapshot or source_text is provenance, not this defect.
findings.required_change_zh: 将这三个现代 label 本地化为 Figure 195，保留 fig-195 身份、数字 195 和全部来源快照。
findings.required_change_en: Localize the three modern label fields to Figure 195 while preserving fig-195, the number 195 and all faithful source data.

findings.title_zh: 英文把相对折射率同时说成输出和表达它所用的输入
findings.title_en: The absolute-index explanation makes the relative index its own input
findings.evidence: express the relative refractive index in terms of the **absolute refractive indices** $n_1$ and $n_2$ of the first and second media and the relative index $n$
findings.detail_zh: 源文和中文现代文说明用两种媒质的绝对折射率表示相对折射率 n。英文却在 in terms of 的列表末尾再加入 and the relative index n，把同一个待表达量也列成所用的量，削弱了从绝对定义得到相对比值的因果说明。后面的式 7.5 没有错误，但不能替代这一句的清楚叙述。
findings.detail_en: The source and Chinese candidate express the relative index n using the absolute indices n1 and n2. The English sentence also lists the relative index n as an input after in terms of. That circular wording obscures what is being derived, even though the later equation is correct.
findings.required_change_zh: 把已有 n 数学片段移到待表达的相对折射率一侧的自然文字说明中，使 n1、n2 为所用定义，n 为结果；保持全部已有数学片段的原有顺序，不新增公式或删除片段。
findings.required_change_en: Make n1 and n2 the absolute indices used and n the relative index being expressed. Rephrase around the existing n token without deleting, adding or reordering any source mathematical token.

source_concept_audit.detail: Card 82 identity and derivation topic retained; the English main title is Deriving the Law of Refraction of Light. The faithful printed_title remains source provenance, not an approved English display heading.

Ray as the direction concept of geometrical optics, experimentally discovered straight propagation in a homogeneous medium, reflection and refraction all survive. Added explanation that a ray is not a real thread is consistent.

Huygens's theoretical wave account, elastic-wave proposal and imagined space-filling ether are explicitly historical. Both candidates deny that modern light requires ether and mention vacuum propagation. Huygens remains declared and bound to the source, not replaced by a fictional name.
Chapter Four mechanical-wave context and the principle's original use for light are retained. Secondary-wave starting points and their common forward boundary introduce the construction.

The source's unrestricted any-wave claim is responsibly qualified to homogeneous, isotropic, linear wavefront propagation at one fixed frequency/color. Homogeneity, isotropy and linear addition are explained rather than merely named.
The literal $47$ reference and mechanical-to-optical reflection reasoning are preserved, with the applicability tied back to the stated model.

Air/water example, Figure 195, plane/same-phase wavefront AC, perpendicular rays A1A/B1B, boundary MN, first arrival A and later C-to-B arrival are retained. A stationary flat interface is stated. Phase speed v1 is defined, and the same start/stop interval is used on both sides before distance/speed gives Delta t.

The fig-195 slot and caption remain in the supplied assembled order after the time equation and before the radius equation. Caption text is localized; the English modern label fields are not. No pixel, placement or geometry approval is inferred.

At B's just-starting wavelet, A's wavelet has propagated for the same elapsed interval. Sphere centered at A, circular-arc cross section and radius |AD|=v2 Delta t are explained in the stated isotropic model.

v2 is explicitly the phase speed of this fixed color in medium 2. Smaller radius at a smaller speed in the same interval connects speed to a possible change of refraction direction; normal incidence is separately excluded from bending later.

Tangent DB, later wavelets with less propagation time, the normal-angle convention, perpendicular-pair angle equality, the right angle at C and equation 7.1 are retained. English fails the standalone side-angle explanation described in D742-01.

Beta is measured from the interface normal and equated to ABD. AD perpendicular to tangent DB explains the right angle at D, and equation 7.2 remains exact. English should name the beta-at-B angle in its independently displayed side-length paragraph instead of the angle; see D742-01.

Both explicitly divide 7.2 by 7.1 and then take reciprocals before the exact displayed 7.3. The sine-ratio form is honestly limited to nonzero incidence/refraction angles; normal incidence is described as unbent and handled before division, not as 0/0.

Relative index means the phase-speed comparison from medium 1 into medium 2. Incidence-angle independence is a statement for the fixed media and fixed frequency/color in this model, not for arbitrary materials, colors or waves. Exact equation 7.4 and source-declared Huygens identity survive.

Beta smaller than alpha implies medium 2's relevant phase speed is smaller and bending is toward the normal in the transmitted-ray situation. The source experimental confirmation in water/transparent media remains, with comparison for the corresponding fixed color.

Absolute-index definitions n1=c/v1 and n2=c/v2, c as vacuum light speed, the same color and reference 7.4 remain. English introductory causality fails D742-03; the definition formulas themselves pass.
Dividing medium 2's absolute index by medium 1's cancels the common c and gives n=v1/v2=n2/n1. Both explain the numerator/denominator direction without reversing the comparison.

Page folios remain frozen source material rather than being invented as learner-prose numbers. Source page metadata 220/210, 221/211 and 222/212 is preserved; n83 heading p0222#5 is outside this review.

formula_audit.independent_quotient_check: 7.2 / 7.1 first gives |AD|/|CB| = v2/v1 = sin(beta)/sin(alpha). Taking reciprocals gives the displayed 7.3. Both candidates explicitly say to take reciprocals; no equation correction or registered erratum is needed.
formula_audit.independent_index_check: (c/v2)/(c/v1) = v1/v2, hence n2/n1 = n. Both retain this direction.
formula_audit.normal_incidence: The two angle sines vanish at normal incidence, so their ratio is not evaluated. Both candidates explicitly exclude it from the ratio form and use the pre-division relations for the unbent case.
formula_audit.figure_reference_number_order: The supplied assembled source order is retained, including the merged pre-figure time-equation block. Exact per-block math tokens and nonmath number sequences match; no source-acquisition or assembly replay was used.
